about_the_game:
The game is currently still in development. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, you can provide feedback through Discord. We sincerely listen to every player's voice!

"SandTable War: Three Kingdoms" is a strategic simulation game set during the Three Kingdoms period. Here you can play as various factions from Three Kingdoms history to conquer cities and lands, unify the realm. With abundant historical officers and scenarios, plus a boardgame-like experience, come restore the Han Dynasty!

Game Features

  • 160+ regions and cities on a grand strategic map for your conquest

  • 400+ historical officers with hundreds of diverse traits; recruit and appoint them to accelerate city development

  • 100+ items and equipment to enhance officer attributes and abilities

  • 20+ regional buildings to construct and develop productivity

  • 10+ playable factions with distinct characteristics and varied gameplay

  • Multiple historical scenarios for immersive experience

  • Manage regional civil and military affairs, adjust taxes and conscription, balance output and public order

  • Earn administrative decrees through development to continuously strengthen your faction

  • Execute secret schemes at opportune moments to turn the tide of war

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
